description: This Java interface defines a retry timeout strategy for backoff mechanisms, providing methods to reset the state, obtain the next timeout duration, and track the number of retries.

classes.name: RetryTimeoutStrategy
classes.description: Interface for retry timeout strategies that provide increasing wait durations between retry attempts.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the timeout calculation and retry counter to initial state.

methods.name: getNextTimeout
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next timeout duration for a retry based on the strategy.

methods.name: getCurrentTries
methods.description: Returns the number of times getNextTimeout() has been called, indicating retry attempts.
